6	
7	interface core_ibex_pmp_fcov_if import ibex_pkg::*; #(
8	    parameter bit          PMPEnable      = 1'b0,
9	    // Granularity of NAPOT access,
10	    // 0 = No restriction, 1 = 8 byte, 2 = 16 byte, 3 = 32 byte, etc.
11	    parameter int unsigned PMPGranularity = 0,
12	    // Number of implemented regions
13	    parameter int unsigned PMPNumRegions  = 4
14	) (
15	  input clk_i,
16	  input rst_ni,
17	
18	  input ibex_pkg::pmp_cfg_t  csr_pmp_cfg     [PMPNumRegions],
19	  input logic[33:0]          csr_pmp_addr    [PMPNumRegions],
20	  input logic                pmp_req_err     [3],
21	  input pmp_mseccfg_t        csr_pmp_mseccfg,
22	
23	  input logic data_req_out,
24	
25	  input fcov_csr_write
26	);
27	  localparam int unsigned PMPNumChan = 3;
28	
29	  `include "dv_fcov_macros.svh"
30	  import uvm_pkg::*;
31	
32	  // Enum to give more readable coverage results for privilege bits. 4 bits are from the pmpcfg CSF
33	  // (L, X, W, R) and the 5th is the MML bit. Setting the MML bit changes the meaning of the other
34	  // 4 bits
35	  typedef enum logic [4:0] {
36	    NONE        = 5'b00000,
37	    R           = 5'b00001,
38	    W           = 5'b00010,
39	    WR          = 5'b00011,
40	    X           = 5'b00100,
41	    XR          = 5'b00101,
42	    XW          = 5'b00110,
43	    XWR         = 5'b00111,
44	    L           = 5'b01000,
45	    LR          = 5'b01001,
46	    LW          = 5'b01010,
47	    LWR         = 5'b01011,
48	    LX          = 5'b01100,
49	    LXR         = 5'b01101,
50	    LXW         = 5'b01110,
51	    LXWR        = 5'b01111,
52	    MML_NONE    = 5'b10000,
53	    MML_RU      = 5'b10001,
54	    MML_WRM_RU  = 5'b10010,
55	    MML_WRU     = 5'b10011,
56	    MML_XU      = 5'b10100,
57	    MML_XRU     = 5'b10101,
58	    MML_WRM_WRU = 5'b10110,
59	    MML_XWRU    = 5'b10111,
60	    MML_L       = 5'b11000,
61	    MML_RM      = 5'b11001,
62	    MML_XM_XU   = 5'b11010,
63	    MML_WRM     = 5'b11011,
64	    MML_XM      = 5'b11100,
65	    MML_XRM     = 5'b11101,
66	    MML_XRM_XU  = 5'b11110,
67	    MML_RM_RU   = 5'b11111
68	  } pmp_priv_bits_e;
69	
70	  // Break out PMP signals into individually named signals for direct use in `cross` as it cannot
71	  // deal with hierarchical references or unpacked arrays.
72	  logic pmp_iside_req_err;
73	  logic pmp_iside2_req_err;
74	  logic pmp_dside_req_err;
75	
76	  assign pmp_iside_req_err  = pmp_req_err[PMP_I];
77	  assign pmp_iside2_req_err = pmp_req_err[PMP_I2];
78	  assign pmp_dside_req_err  = pmp_req_err[PMP_D];
79	
80	  logic [PMPNumRegions-1:0] current_priv_perm_check;
81	  bit en_pmp_fcov;
82	
83	  logic csr_wdata_mseccfg_rlb;
84	  logic csr_wdata_mseccfg_mmwp;
85	  logic csr_wdata_mseccfg_mml;
86	
87	  assign csr_wdata_mseccfg_rlb = cs_registers_i.csr_wdata_int[CSR_MSECCFG_RLB_BIT];
88	  assign csr_wdata_mseccfg_mmwp = cs_registers_i.csr_wdata_int[CSR_MSECCFG_MMWP_BIT];
89	  assign csr_wdata_mseccfg_mml = cs_registers_i.csr_wdata_int[CSR_MSECCFG_MML_BIT];
90	
91	  initial begin
92	    if (PMPEnable) begin
93	      void'($value$plusargs("enable_ibex_fcov=%d", en_pmp_fcov));
94	    end else begin
95	      en_pmp_fcov = 1'b0;
96	    end
97	  end
98	
99	  if (PMPEnable) begin : g_pmp_cgs
100	    logic [PMPNumRegions-1:0] pmp_iside_match;
101	    logic [PMPNumRegions-1:0] pmp_iside2_match;
102	    logic [PMPNumRegions-1:0] pmp_dside_match;
103	    logic [PMPNumRegions-1:0] pmp_dside_match_last;
104	
105	    logic pmp_iside_nomatch;
106	    logic pmp_iside2_nomatch;
107	    logic pmp_dside_nomatch;
108	
109	    logic pmp_iside_boundary_cross;
110	    logic pmp_dside_boundary_cross;
111	
112	    logic misaligned_pmp_err_last;
113	
114	    logic [31:0] pmp_addr_napot_valid [PMPNumRegions];
115	
116	    assign pmp_iside_match      = g_pmp.pmp_i.region_match_all[PMP_I];
117	    assign pmp_iside2_match     = g_pmp.pmp_i.region_match_all[PMP_I2];
118	    assign pmp_dside_match      = g_pmp.pmp_i.region_match_all[PMP_D];
119	
120	    assign pmp_iside_nomatch  = ~|pmp_iside_match;
121	    assign pmp_iside2_nomatch = ~|pmp_iside2_match;
122	    assign pmp_dside_nomatch  = ~|pmp_dside_match;
123	
124	    // Store the Data Channel PMP match info from the first request to calculate boundary cross
125	    always @(posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni) begin
126	      if (!rst_ni) begin
127	        pmp_dside_match_last    <= '0;
128	        misaligned_pmp_err_last <= 1'b0;
129	      end else if (load_store_unit_i.fcov_ls_first_req) begin
130	        pmp_dside_match_last    <= pmp_dside_match;
131	        misaligned_pmp_err_last <= load_store_unit_i.data_pmp_err_i;
132	      end
133	    end
134	
135	    assign pmp_iside_boundary_cross = |(pmp_iside_match ^ pmp_iside2_match);
136	    assign pmp_dside_boundary_cross = |(pmp_dside_match ^ pmp_dside_match_last) &
137	                                      load_store_unit_i.fcov_ls_second_req;
138	
139	    for (genvar i_region = 0; i_region < PMPNumRegions; i_region += 1) begin : g_pmp_region_fcov
140	      pmp_priv_bits_e pmp_region_priv_bits;
141	      pmp_priv_bits_e pmp_region_priv_bits_wr;
142	
143	      assign pmp_region_priv_bits = pmp_priv_bits_e'({csr_pmp_mseccfg.mml,
144	                                                      csr_pmp_cfg[i_region].lock,
145	                                                      csr_pmp_cfg[i_region].exec,
146	                                                      csr_pmp_cfg[i_region].write,
147	                                                      csr_pmp_cfg[i_region].read});
148	      assign pmp_region_priv_bits_wr =
149	          pmp_priv_bits_e'({csr_pmp_mseccfg.mml,
150	                            cs_registers_i.g_pmp_registers.pmp_cfg_wdata[i_region].lock,
151	                            cs_registers_i.g_pmp_registers.pmp_cfg_wdata[i_region].exec,
152	                            cs_registers_i.g_pmp_registers.pmp_cfg_wdata[i_region].write,
153	                            cs_registers_i.g_pmp_registers.pmp_cfg_wdata[i_region].read});
154	
155	      // Do the permission check for Data channel with the privilege level from Instruction channels.
156	      // This way we can check the effect of mstatus.mprv changing privilege levels for LSU related
157	      // operations.
158	      assign current_priv_perm_check[i_region] =
159	        g_pmp.pmp_i.perm_check_wrapper(csr_pmp_mseccfg.mml,
160	                                       csr_pmp_cfg[i_region],
161	                                       g_pmp.pmp_i.pmp_req_type_i[PMP_D],
162	                                       cs_registers_i.priv_mode_id_o,
163	                                       g_pmp.pmp_i.region_basic_perm_check[PMP_D][i_region]);
164	
165	      // Each cycle this assignment creates either the value 0 if the mode is not NAPOT or 1 bit is
166	      // set based on how large the NAPOT region is. The size of the NAPOT region is essentially
167	      // encoded by how many consecutive ones there are after the last 0. This encoding is
168	      // specified in the "Physical Memory Protection" section of the RISC-V privileged spec.
169	      for (genvar i = 0; i < 32; i += 1) begin : g_pmp_napot_region_fcov
170	        assign pmp_addr_napot_valid[i_region][i] = csr_pmp_cfg[i_region].mode == PMP_MODE_NAPOT &&
171	          (csr_pmp_addr[i_region][i+2:2] == {1'b0, {i{1'b1}}});
172	      end
173	
174	      covergroup pmp_region_cg @(posedge clk_i);
175	        option.per_instance = 1;
176	        option.name = "pmp_region_cg";
177	
178	        // This coverpoint converts pmp_add_napot_valid into 32 bins. The onehot call makes sure
179	        // that when the entry is not in NAPOT mode, then no bin is selected. The clog2 call
180	        // converts the value 0...010...0 to the index of the one bit that is set.
181	        cp_napot_addr_modes: coverpoint $clog2(pmp_addr_napot_valid[i_region])
182	          iff ($onehot(pmp_addr_napot_valid[i_region])) {
183	          bins napot_addr[] = { [0:31] };
184	        }
185	
186	        cp_warl_check_pmpcfg : coverpoint
187	          g_pmp_fcov_signals.g_pmp_region_fcov[i_region].fcov_warl_check_pmpcfg;
188	
189	        cp_region_mode : coverpoint csr_pmp_cfg[i_region].mode;
190	
191	        cp_region_priv_bits : coverpoint pmp_region_priv_bits {
192	          wildcard illegal_bins illegal = {5'b0??10};
193	        }
194	
195	        cp_priv_lvl_iside : coverpoint g_pmp.pmp_priv_lvl[PMP_I] {
196	          illegal_bins illegal = {PRIV_LVL_H, PRIV_LVL_S};
197	        }
198	
199	        cp_req_type_iside : coverpoint g_pmp.pmp_req_type[PMP_I] {
200	          illegal_bins illegal = {PMP_ACC_WRITE, PMP_ACC_READ};
201	        }
202	
203	        cp_priv_lvl_iside2 : coverpoint g_pmp.pmp_priv_lvl[PMP_I2] {
204	          illegal_bins illegal = {PRIV_LVL_H, PRIV_LVL_S};
205	        }
206	
207	        cp_req_type_iside2 : coverpoint g_pmp.pmp_req_type[PMP_I2] {
208	          illegal_bins illegal = {PMP_ACC_WRITE, PMP_ACC_READ};
209	        }
210	
211	        cp_priv_lvl_dside : coverpoint g_pmp.pmp_priv_lvl[PMP_D] {
212	          illegal_bins illegal = {PRIV_LVL_H, PRIV_LVL_S};
213	        }
214	
215	        cp_req_type_dside : coverpoint g_pmp.pmp_req_type[PMP_D] {
216	          illegal_bins illegal = {PMP_ACC_EXEC};
217	        }
218	
219	        // Wildcards in crosses are not supported by VCS. As a workaround we are using `with`
220	        // keyword and basic logic expressions to constraint the condition as appropriate.
221	        pmp_iside_mode_cross : cross cp_region_mode, pmp_iside_req_err
222	          iff (g_pmp_fcov_signals.g_pmp_region_fcov[i_region].fcov_pmp_region_ichan_access) {
223	            illegal_bins illegal_off_mode_match = binsof(cp_region_mode) intersect {PMP_MODE_OFF};
224	          }
225	
226	        pmp_iside2_mode_cross : cross cp_region_mode, pmp_iside2_req_err
227	          iff (g_pmp_fcov_signals.g_pmp_region_fcov[i_region].fcov_pmp_region_ichan2_access) {
228	            illegal_bins illegal_off_mode_match = binsof(cp_region_mode) intersect {PMP_MODE_OFF};
229	          }
230	
231	        pmp_dside_mode_cross : cross cp_region_mode, pmp_dside_req_err
232	          iff (g_pmp_fcov_signals.g_pmp_region_fcov[i_region].fcov_pmp_region_dchan_access) {
233	            illegal_bins illegal_off_mode_match = binsof(cp_region_mode) intersect {PMP_MODE_OFF};
234	          }
235	
236	        pmp_iside_priv_bits_cross :
237	          cross cp_region_priv_bits, cp_req_type_iside, cp_priv_lvl_iside, pmp_iside_req_err
238	            iff (g_pmp_fcov_signals.g_pmp_region_fcov[i_region].fcov_pmp_region_ichan_access &&
239	                 g_pmp_fcov_signals.fcov_pmp_region_ichan_priority[i_region]                 &&
240	                 csr_pmp_cfg[i_region].mode != PMP_MODE_OFF) {
241	
242	            // Will never see a succesful exec access when execute is disallowed
243	            illegal_bins illegal_allow_exec =
244	              // Ensuring MML is low and we are not in a X allowed configuration
245	              (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {NONE, R, W, WR, L, LR, LW, LWR} &&
246	               binsof(cp_req_type_iside) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
247	               binsof(pmp_iside_req_err) intersect {0}) with (cp_priv_lvl_iside == PRIV_LVL_U ||
248	                                                              (|(cp_region_priv_bits & 5'b01000)));
249	            illegal_bins illegal_machine_allow_exec =
250	              // Ensuring MML is high and we are not in a X allowed configuration in Machine Mode
251	              (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {MML_NONE, MML_RU, MML_WRM_RU, MML_WRU, MML_XU,
252	                                                   MML_XRU, MML_WRM_WRU, MML_XWRU, MML_L, MML_RM,
253	                                                   MML_WRM, MML_RM_RU} &&
254	               binsof(cp_priv_lvl_iside) intersect {PRIV_LVL_M} &&
255	               binsof(cp_req_type_iside) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
256	               binsof(pmp_iside_req_err) intersect {0});
257	            illegal_bins illegal_user_allow_exec =
258	              // Ensuring MML is high and we are not in a X allowed configuration in User Mode
259	              (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {MML_NONE, MML_RU, MML_WRM_RU, MML_WRU,
260	                                                      MML_WRM_WRU, MML_L, MML_RM, MML_WRM,
261	                                                      MML_XM, MML_XRM, MML_RM_RU} &&
262	               binsof(cp_priv_lvl_iside) intersect {PRIV_LVL_U} &&
263	               binsof(cp_req_type_iside) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
264	               binsof(pmp_iside_req_err) intersect {0});
265	            // Will never see an exec access denied when executed is allowed
266	            illegal_bins illegal_deny_exec =
267	              // Ensuring MML is low and we are in a X allowed configuration
268	              (binsof(cp_req_type_iside) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
269	               binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {X, XW, XR, XWR, LX, LXW, LXR, LXWR} &&
270	               binsof(pmp_iside_req_err) intersect {1});
271	            illegal_bins illegal_deny_exec_machine_unlocked =
272	              // Ensuring in machine mode when MML is low, we are in X allowed configuration
273	              (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {R, W, WR} &&
274	               binsof(cp_req_type_iside) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
275	               binsof(cp_priv_lvl_iside) intersect {PRIV_LVL_M} &&
276	               binsof(pmp_iside_req_err) intersect {1});
277	            illegal_bins illegal_machine_deny_exec =
278	              // Ensuring MML is high and we are in a X allowed configuration in Machine Mode
279	              (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {NONE, MML_XM_XU, MML_XRM_XU, MML_XRM,
280	                                                      MML_XM} &&
281	               binsof(cp_priv_lvl_iside) intersect {PRIV_LVL_M} &&
282	               binsof(cp_req_type_iside) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
283	               binsof(pmp_iside_req_err) intersect {1});
284	            illegal_bins illegal_user_deny_exec =
285	              // Ensuring MML is high and we are in a X allowed configuration in User Mode
286	              (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {MML_XM_XU, MML_XRM_XU, MML_XRU, MML_XU,
287	                                                      MML_XWRU} &&
288	               binsof(cp_priv_lvl_iside) intersect {PRIV_LVL_U} &&
289	               binsof(cp_req_type_iside) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
290	               binsof(pmp_iside_req_err) intersect {1});
291	        }
292	
293	        pmp_iside2_priv_bits_cross :
294	          cross cp_region_priv_bits, cp_req_type_iside2, cp_priv_lvl_iside2, pmp_iside2_req_err
295	            iff (g_pmp_fcov_signals.g_pmp_region_fcov[i_region].fcov_pmp_region_ichan2_access &&
296	                 g_pmp_fcov_signals.fcov_pmp_region_ichan2_priority[i_region]                 &&
297	                 csr_pmp_cfg[i_region].mode != PMP_MODE_OFF) {
298	
299	          // Will never see a succesful exec access when execute is disallowed
300	          illegal_bins illegal_allow_exec =
301	            // Ensuring MML is low and we are not in a X allowed configuration
302	            (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {NONE, R, W, WR, L, LR, LW, LWR} &&
303	             binsof(cp_req_type_iside2) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
304	             binsof(pmp_iside2_req_err) intersect {0}) with (cp_priv_lvl_iside2 == PRIV_LVL_U ||
305	                                                             (cp_region_priv_bits & 5'b01000));
306	          illegal_bins illegal_machine_allow_exec =
307	            // Ensuring MML is high and we are not in a X allowed configuration in Machine Mode
308	            (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {MML_NONE, MML_RU, MML_WRM_RU, MML_WRU, MML_XU,
309	                                                 MML_XRU, MML_WRM_WRU, MML_XWRU, MML_L, MML_RM,
310	                                                 MML_WRM, MML_RM_RU} &&
311	             binsof(cp_priv_lvl_iside2) intersect {PRIV_LVL_M} &&
312	             binsof(cp_req_type_iside2) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
313	             binsof(pmp_iside2_req_err) intersect {0});
314	          illegal_bins illegal_user_allow_exec =
315	            // Ensuring MML is high and we are not in a X allowed configuration in User Mode
316	            (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {MML_NONE, MML_RU, MML_WRM_RU, MML_WRU,
317	                                                    MML_WRM_WRU, MML_L, MML_RM, MML_WRM,
318	                                                    MML_XM, MML_XRM, MML_RM_RU} &&
319	             binsof(cp_priv_lvl_iside2) intersect {PRIV_LVL_U} &&
320	             binsof(cp_req_type_iside2) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
321	             binsof(pmp_iside2_req_err) intersect {0});
322	
323	          // Will never see an exec access denied when execute is allowed
324	          illegal_bins illegal_deny_exec =
325	            // Ensuring MML is low and we are in a X allowed configuration
326	            (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {X, XW, XR, XWR, LX, LXW, LXR, LXWR} &&
327	             binsof(cp_req_type_iside2) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
328	             binsof(pmp_iside2_req_err) intersect {1});
329	          illegal_bins illegal_deny_exec_machine_unlocked =
330	            // Ensuring in machine mode when MML is low, we are in X allowed configuration
331	            (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {R, W, WR} &&
332	             binsof(cp_req_type_iside2) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
333	             binsof(cp_priv_lvl_iside2) intersect {PRIV_LVL_M} &&
334	             binsof(pmp_iside2_req_err) intersect {1});
335	          illegal_bins illegal_machine_deny_exec =
336	            // Ensuring MML is high and we are in a X allowed configuration in Machine Mode
337	            (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {NONE, MML_XM_XU, MML_XRM_XU, MML_XRM, MML_XM} &&
338	             binsof(cp_priv_lvl_iside2) intersect {PRIV_LVL_M} &&
339	             binsof(cp_req_type_iside2) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
340	             binsof(pmp_iside2_req_err) intersect {1});
341	          illegal_bins illegal_user_deny_exec =
342	            // Ensuring MML is high and we are in a X allowed configuration in User Mode
343	            (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {MML_XM_XU, MML_XRM_XU, MML_XRU, MML_XU,
344	                                                      MML_XWRU} &&
345	             binsof(cp_priv_lvl_iside2) intersect {PRIV_LVL_U} &&
346	             binsof(cp_req_type_iside2) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
347	             binsof(pmp_iside2_req_err) intersect {1});
348	        }
349	
350	        pmp_dside_priv_bits_cross :
351	          cross cp_region_priv_bits, cp_req_type_dside, cp_priv_lvl_dside, pmp_dside_req_err
352	            iff (g_pmp_fcov_signals.g_pmp_region_fcov[i_region].fcov_pmp_region_dchan_access &&
353	                 g_pmp_fcov_signals.fcov_pmp_region_dchan_priority[i_region]                 &&
354	                 csr_pmp_cfg[i_region].mode != PMP_MODE_OFF) {
355	
356	          // Will never see a succesful read access when read is disallowed
357	          illegal_bins illegal_allow_read =
358	            // Ensuring MML is low and we are not in a R allowed configuration
359	            (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {NONE, W, X, XW, L, LW, LX, LXW} &&
360	             binsof(cp_req_type_dside) intersect {PMP_ACC_READ} &&
361	             binsof(pmp_dside_req_err) intersect {0})
362	            with (cp_priv_lvl_dside == PRIV_LVL_U || (cp_region_priv_bits & 5'b01000));
363	          illegal_bins illegal_machine_allow_read =
364	            // Ensuring MML is high and we are not in a R allowed configuration in Machine Mode
365	            (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {MML_NONE, MML_RU, MML_WRU, MML_XU, MML_XRU,
366	                                                    MML_XWRU, MML_L, MML_XM_XU, MML_XM} &&
367	             binsof(cp_priv_lvl_dside) intersect {PRIV_LVL_M} &&

45	  // Flow of the PMP checking operation follows as below
46	  //
47	  // basic_perm_check ---> perm_check_wrapper ---> mml_perm_check/orig_perm_check ---/
48	  //                                                                                 |
49	  // region_match_all --------------------------------> access_fault_check <----------
50	  //                                                            |
51	  //                                                            \--> pmp_req_err_o

53	  // Compute permissions checks that apply when MSECCFG.MML is set. Added for Smepmp support.
54	  function automatic logic mml_perm_check(ibex_pkg::pmp_cfg_t  region_csr_pmp_cfg,
55	                                          ibex_pkg::pmp_req_e  pmp_req_type,
56	                                          ibex_pkg::priv_lvl_e priv_mode,
57	                                          logic                permission_check);
58	    logic result = 1'b0;
59	    logic unused_cfg = |region_csr_pmp_cfg.mode;
60	
61	    if (!region_csr_pmp_cfg.read && region_csr_pmp_cfg.write) begin
62	      // Special-case shared regions where R = 0, W = 1
63	      unique case ({region_csr_pmp_cfg.lock, region_csr_pmp_cfg.exec})
64	        // Read/write in M, read only in S/U
65	        2'b00: result =
66	            (pmp_req_type == PMP_ACC_READ) |
67	            ((pmp_req_type == PMP_ACC_WRITE) & (priv_mode == PRIV_LVL_M));
68	        // Read/write in M/S/U
69	        2'b01: result =
70	            (pmp_req_type == PMP_ACC_READ) | (pmp_req_type == PMP_ACC_WRITE);
71	        // Execute only on M/S/U
72	        2'b10: result = (pmp_req_type == PMP_ACC_EXEC);
73	        // Read/execute in M, execute only on S/U
74	        2'b11: result =
75	            (pmp_req_type == PMP_ACC_EXEC) |
76	            ((pmp_req_type == PMP_ACC_READ) & (priv_mode == PRIV_LVL_M));
77	        default: ;
78	      endcase
79	    end else begin
80	      if (region_csr_pmp_cfg.read & region_csr_pmp_cfg.write &
81	          region_csr_pmp_cfg.exec & region_csr_pmp_cfg.lock) begin
82	        // Special-case shared read only region when R = 1, W = 1, X = 1, L = 1
83	        result = pmp_req_type == PMP_ACC_READ;
84	      end else begin
85	        // Otherwise use basic permission check. Permission is always denied if in S/U mode and
86	        // L is set or if in M mode and L is unset.
87	        result = permission_check &
88	                 (priv_mode == PRIV_LVL_M ? region_csr_pmp_cfg.lock : ~region_csr_pmp_cfg.lock);
89	      end
90	    end
91	    return result;
92	  endfunction

94	  // Compute permissions checks that apply when MSECCFG.MML is unset. This is the original PMP
95	  // behaviour before Smepmp was added.
96	  function automatic logic orig_perm_check(logic                pmp_cfg_lock,
97	                                           ibex_pkg::priv_lvl_e priv_mode,
98	                                           logic                permission_check);
99	      return (priv_mode == PRIV_LVL_M) ?
100	          // For M-mode, any region which matches with the L-bit clear, or with sufficient
101	          // access permissions will be allowed
102	          (~pmp_cfg_lock | permission_check) :
103	          // For other modes, the lock bit doesn't matter
104	          permission_check;
105	  endfunction

107	  // A wrapper function in which it is decided which form of permission check function gets called
108	  function automatic logic perm_check_wrapper(logic                csr_pmp_mseccfg_mml,
109	                                              ibex_pkg::pmp_cfg_t  region_csr_pmp_cfg,
110	                                              ibex_pkg::pmp_req_e  pmp_req_type,
111	                                              ibex_pkg::priv_lvl_e priv_mode,
112	                                              logic                permission_check);
113	    return csr_pmp_mseccfg_mml ? mml_perm_check(region_csr_pmp_cfg,
114	                                                pmp_req_type,
115	                                                priv_mode,
116	                                                permission_check) :
117	                                 orig_perm_check(region_csr_pmp_cfg.lock,
118	                                                 priv_mode,
119	                                                 permission_check);
120	  endfunction

122	  // Access fault determination / prioritization
123	  function automatic logic access_fault_check (logic                     csr_pmp_mseccfg_mmwp,
124	                                               logic                     csr_pmp_mseccfg_mml,
125	                                               ibex_pkg::pmp_req_e       pmp_req_type,
126	                                               logic [PMPNumRegions-1:0] match_all,
127	                                               ibex_pkg::priv_lvl_e      priv_mode,
128	                                               logic [PMPNumRegions-1:0] final_perm_check);
129	
130	
131	    // When MSECCFG.MMWP is set default deny always, otherwise allow for M-mode, deny for other
132	    // modes. Also deny unmatched for M-mode whe MSECCFG.MML is set and request type is EXEC.
133	    logic access_fail = csr_pmp_mseccfg_mmwp | (priv_mode != PRIV_LVL_M) |
134	                        (csr_pmp_mseccfg_mml && (pmp_req_type == PMP_ACC_EXEC));
135	    logic matched = 1'b0;
136	
137	    // PMP entries are statically prioritized, from 0 to N-1
138	    // The lowest-numbered PMP entry which matches an address determines accessibility
139	    for (int r = 0; r < PMPNumRegions; r++) begin
140	      if (!matched && match_all[r]) begin
141	        access_fail = ~final_perm_check[r];
142	        matched = 1'b1;
143	      end
144	    end
145	    return access_fail;
146	  endfunction

148	  // ---------------
149	  // Access checking
150	  // ---------------
151	
152	  for (genvar r = 0; r < PMPNumRegions; r++) begin : g_addr_exp
153	    // Start address for TOR matching
154	    if (r == 0) begin : g_entry0
155	      assign region_start_addr[r] = (csr_pmp_cfg_i[r].mode == PMP_MODE_TOR) ? 34'h000000000 :
156	                                                                              csr_pmp_addr_i[r];
157	    end else begin : g_oth
158	      assign region_start_addr[r] = (csr_pmp_cfg_i[r].mode == PMP_MODE_TOR) ? csr_pmp_addr_i[r-1] :
159	                                                                              csr_pmp_addr_i[r];
160	    end
161	    // Address mask for NA matching
162	    for (genvar b = PMPGranularity + 2; b < 34; b++) begin : g_bitmask
163	      if (b == 2) begin : g_bit0
164	        // Always mask bit 2 for NAPOT
165	        assign region_addr_mask[r][b] = (csr_pmp_cfg_i[r].mode != PMP_MODE_NAPOT);
166	      end else begin : g_others
167	        // We will mask this bit if it is within the programmed granule
168	        // i.e. addr = yyyy 0111
169	        //                  ^
170	        //                  | This bit pos is the top of the mask, all lower bits set
171	        // thus mask = 1111 0000
172	        if (PMPGranularity == 0) begin : g_region_addr_mask_zero_granularity
173	          assign region_addr_mask[r][b] = (csr_pmp_cfg_i[r].mode != PMP_MODE_NAPOT) |
174	                                          ~&csr_pmp_addr_i[r][b-1:2];
175	        end else begin : g_region_addr_mask_other_granularity
176	          assign region_addr_mask[r][b] = (csr_pmp_cfg_i[r].mode != PMP_MODE_NAPOT) |
177	                                          ~&csr_pmp_addr_i[r][b-1:PMPGranularity+1];
178	        end
179	      end
180	    end
181	  end
182	
183	  for (genvar c = 0; c < PMPNumChan; c++) begin : g_access_check
184	    for (genvar r = 0; r < PMPNumRegions; r++) begin : g_regions
185	      // Comparators are sized according to granularity
186	      assign region_match_eq[c][r] = (pmp_req_addr_i[c][33:PMPGranularity+2] &
187	                                      region_addr_mask[r]) ==
188	                                     (region_start_addr[r][33:PMPGranularity+2] &
189	                                      region_addr_mask[r]);
190	      assign region_match_gt[c][r] = pmp_req_addr_i[c][33:PMPGranularity+2] >
191	                                     region_start_addr[r][33:PMPGranularity+2];
192	      assign region_match_lt[c][r] = pmp_req_addr_i[c][33:PMPGranularity+2] <
193	                                     csr_pmp_addr_i[r][33:PMPGranularity+2];
194	
195	      always_comb begin
196	        region_match_all[c][r] = 1'b0;
197	        unique case (csr_pmp_cfg_i[r].mode)
198	          PMP_MODE_OFF:   region_match_all[c][r] = 1'b0;
199	          PMP_MODE_NA4:   region_match_all[c][r] = region_match_eq[c][r];
200	          PMP_MODE_NAPOT: region_match_all[c][r] = region_match_eq[c][r];
201	          PMP_MODE_TOR: begin
202	            region_match_all[c][r] = (region_match_eq[c][r] | region_match_gt[c][r]) &
203	                                     region_match_lt[c][r];
204	          end
205	          default:        region_match_all[c][r] = 1'b0;
206	        endcase
207	      end
208	
209	      // Basic permission check compares cfg register only.
210	      assign region_basic_perm_check[c][r] =
211	          ((pmp_req_type_i[c] == PMP_ACC_EXEC)  & csr_pmp_cfg_i[r].exec) |
212	          ((pmp_req_type_i[c] == PMP_ACC_WRITE) & csr_pmp_cfg_i[r].write) |
213	          ((pmp_req_type_i[c] == PMP_ACC_READ)  & csr_pmp_cfg_i[r].read);
214	
215	      // Check specific required permissions since the behaviour is different
216	      // between Smepmp implementation and original PMP.
217	      assign region_perm_check[c][r] = perm_check_wrapper(csr_pmp_mseccfg_i.mml,
218	                                                          csr_pmp_cfg_i[r],
219	                                                          pmp_req_type_i[c],
220	                                                          priv_mode_i[c],
221	                                                          region_basic_perm_check[c][r]);
222	
223	      // Address bits below PMP granularity (which starts at 4 byte) are deliberately unused.
224	      logic unused_sigs;
225	      assign unused_sigs = ^{region_start_addr[r][PMPGranularity+2-1:0],
226	                             pmp_req_addr_i[c][PMPGranularity+2-1:0]};
227	    end
228	
229	    // Once the permission checks of the regions are done, decide if the access is
230	    // denied by figuring out the matching region and its permission check.
231	    assign pmp_req_err_o[c] = access_fault_check(csr_pmp_mseccfg_i.mmwp,
232	                                                 csr_pmp_mseccfg_i.mml,
233	                                                 pmp_req_type_i[c],
234	                                                 region_match_all[c],
235	                                                 priv_mode_i[c],
236	                                                 region_perm_check[c]);
237	
238	    // Access fails check against one region but access allowed due to another higher-priority
239	    // region.
240	    `DV_FCOV_SIGNAL(logic, pmp_region_override,
241	      ~pmp_req_err_o[c] & |(region_match_all[c] & ~region_perm_check[c]))
242	  end

247	  assign unused_csr_pmp_mseccfg_rlb = csr_pmp_mseccfg_i.rlb;

7	interface core_ibex_pmp_fcov_if import ibex_pkg::*; #(
8	    parameter bit          PMPEnable      = 1'b0,
9	    // Granularity of NAPOT access,
10	    // 0 = No restriction, 1 = 8 byte, 2 = 16 byte, 3 = 32 byte, etc.
11	    parameter int unsigned PMPGranularity = 0,
12	    // Number of implemented regions
13	    parameter int unsigned PMPNumRegions  = 4
14	) (
15	  input clk_i,
16	  input rst_ni,
17	
18	  input ibex_pkg::pmp_cfg_t  csr_pmp_cfg     [PMPNumRegions],
19	  input logic[33:0]          csr_pmp_addr    [PMPNumRegions],
20	  input logic                pmp_req_err     [3],
21	  input pmp_mseccfg_t        csr_pmp_mseccfg,
22	
23	  input logic data_req_out,
24	
25	  input fcov_csr_write
26	);
27	  localparam int unsigned PMPNumChan = 3;
28	
29	  `include "dv_fcov_macros.svh"
30	  import uvm_pkg::*;
31	
32	  // Enum to give more readable coverage results for privilege bits. 4 bits are from the pmpcfg CSF
33	  // (L, X, W, R) and the 5th is the MML bit. Setting the MML bit changes the meaning of the other
34	  // 4 bits
35	  typedef enum logic [4:0] {
36	    NONE        = 5'b00000,
37	    R           = 5'b00001,
38	    W           = 5'b00010,
39	    WR          = 5'b00011,
40	    X           = 5'b00100,
41	    XR          = 5'b00101,
42	    XW          = 5'b00110,
43	    XWR         = 5'b00111,
44	    L           = 5'b01000,
45	    LR          = 5'b01001,
46	    LW          = 5'b01010,
47	    LWR         = 5'b01011,
48	    LX          = 5'b01100,
49	    LXR         = 5'b01101,
50	    LXW         = 5'b01110,
51	    LXWR        = 5'b01111,
52	    MML_NONE    = 5'b10000,
53	    MML_RU      = 5'b10001,
54	    MML_WRM_RU  = 5'b10010,
55	    MML_WRU     = 5'b10011,
56	    MML_XU      = 5'b10100,
57	    MML_XRU     = 5'b10101,
58	    MML_WRM_WRU = 5'b10110,
59	    MML_XWRU    = 5'b10111,
60	    MML_L       = 5'b11000,
61	    MML_RM      = 5'b11001,
62	    MML_XM_XU   = 5'b11010,
63	    MML_WRM     = 5'b11011,
64	    MML_XM      = 5'b11100,
65	    MML_XRM     = 5'b11101,
66	    MML_XRM_XU  = 5'b11110,
67	    MML_RM_RU   = 5'b11111
68	  } pmp_priv_bits_e;
69	
70	  // Break out PMP signals into individually named signals for direct use in `cross` as it cannot
71	  // deal with hierarchical references or unpacked arrays.
72	  logic pmp_iside_req_err;
73	  logic pmp_iside2_req_err;
74	  logic pmp_dside_req_err;
75	
76	  assign pmp_iside_req_err  = pmp_req_err[PMP_I];
77	  assign pmp_iside2_req_err = pmp_req_err[PMP_I2];
78	  assign pmp_dside_req_err  = pmp_req_err[PMP_D];
79	
80	  logic [PMPNumRegions-1:0] current_priv_perm_check;
81	  bit en_pmp_fcov;
82	
83	  logic csr_wdata_mseccfg_rlb;
84	  logic csr_wdata_mseccfg_mmwp;
85	  logic csr_wdata_mseccfg_mml;
86	
87	  assign csr_wdata_mseccfg_rlb = cs_registers_i.csr_wdata_int[CSR_MSECCFG_RLB_BIT];
88	  assign csr_wdata_mseccfg_mmwp = cs_registers_i.csr_wdata_int[CSR_MSECCFG_MMWP_BIT];
89	  assign csr_wdata_mseccfg_mml = cs_registers_i.csr_wdata_int[CSR_MSECCFG_MML_BIT];
90	
91	  initial begin
92	    if (PMPEnable) begin
93	      void'($value$plusargs("enable_ibex_fcov=%d", en_pmp_fcov));
94	    end else begin
95	      en_pmp_fcov = 1'b0;
96	    end
97	  end
98	
99	  if (PMPEnable) begin : g_pmp_cgs
100	    logic [PMPNumRegions-1:0] pmp_iside_match;
101	    logic [PMPNumRegions-1:0] pmp_iside2_match;
102	    logic [PMPNumRegions-1:0] pmp_dside_match;
103	    logic [PMPNumRegions-1:0] pmp_dside_match_last;
104	
105	    logic pmp_iside_nomatch;
106	    logic pmp_iside2_nomatch;
107	    logic pmp_dside_nomatch;
108	
109	    logic pmp_iside_boundary_cross;
110	    logic pmp_dside_boundary_cross;
111	
112	    logic misaligned_pmp_err_last;
113	
114	    logic [31:0] pmp_addr_napot_valid [PMPNumRegions];
115	
116	    assign pmp_iside_match      = g_pmp.pmp_i.region_match_all[PMP_I];
117	    assign pmp_iside2_match     = g_pmp.pmp_i.region_match_all[PMP_I2];
118	    assign pmp_dside_match      = g_pmp.pmp_i.region_match_all[PMP_D];
119	
120	    assign pmp_iside_nomatch  = ~|pmp_iside_match;
121	    assign pmp_iside2_nomatch = ~|pmp_iside2_match;
122	    assign pmp_dside_nomatch  = ~|pmp_dside_match;
123	
124	    // Store the Data Channel PMP match info from the first request to calculate boundary cross
125	    always @(posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni) begin
126	      if (!rst_ni) begin
127	        pmp_dside_match_last    <= '0;
128	        misaligned_pmp_err_last <= 1'b0;
129	      end else if (load_store_unit_i.fcov_ls_first_req) begin
130	        pmp_dside_match_last    <= pmp_dside_match;
131	        misaligned_pmp_err_last <= load_store_unit_i.data_pmp_err_i;
132	      end
133	    end
134	
135	    assign pmp_iside_boundary_cross = |(pmp_iside_match ^ pmp_iside2_match);
136	    assign pmp_dside_boundary_cross = |(pmp_dside_match ^ pmp_dside_match_last) &
137	                                      load_store_unit_i.fcov_ls_second_req;
138	
139	    for (genvar i_region = 0; i_region < PMPNumRegions; i_region += 1) begin : g_pmp_region_fcov
140	      pmp_priv_bits_e pmp_region_priv_bits;
141	      pmp_priv_bits_e pmp_region_priv_bits_wr;
142	
143	      assign pmp_region_priv_bits = pmp_priv_bits_e'({csr_pmp_mseccfg.mml,
144	                                                      csr_pmp_cfg[i_region].lock,
145	                                                      csr_pmp_cfg[i_region].exec,
146	                                                      csr_pmp_cfg[i_region].write,
147	                                                      csr_pmp_cfg[i_region].read});
148	      assign pmp_region_priv_bits_wr =
149	          pmp_priv_bits_e'({csr_pmp_mseccfg.mml,
150	                            cs_registers_i.g_pmp_registers.pmp_cfg_wdata[i_region].lock,
151	                            cs_registers_i.g_pmp_registers.pmp_cfg_wdata[i_region].exec,
152	                            cs_registers_i.g_pmp_registers.pmp_cfg_wdata[i_region].write,
153	                            cs_registers_i.g_pmp_registers.pmp_cfg_wdata[i_region].read});
154	
155	      // Do the permission check for Data channel with the privilege level from Instruction channels.
156	      // This way we can check the effect of mstatus.mprv changing privilege levels for LSU related
157	      // operations.
158	      assign current_priv_perm_check[i_region] =
159	        g_pmp.pmp_i.perm_check_wrapper(csr_pmp_mseccfg.mml,
160	                                       csr_pmp_cfg[i_region],
161	                                       g_pmp.pmp_i.pmp_req_type_i[PMP_D],
162	                                       cs_registers_i.priv_mode_id_o,
163	                                       g_pmp.pmp_i.region_basic_perm_check[PMP_D][i_region]);
164	
165	      // Each cycle this assignment creates either the value 0 if the mode is not NAPOT or 1 bit is
166	      // set based on how large the NAPOT region is. The size of the NAPOT region is essentially
167	      // encoded by how many consecutive ones there are after the last 0. This encoding is
168	      // specified in the "Physical Memory Protection" section of the RISC-V privileged spec.
169	      for (genvar i = 0; i < 32; i += 1) begin : g_pmp_napot_region_fcov
170	        assign pmp_addr_napot_valid[i_region][i] = csr_pmp_cfg[i_region].mode == PMP_MODE_NAPOT &&
171	          (csr_pmp_addr[i_region][i+2:2] == {1'b0, {i{1'b1}}});
172	      end
173	
174	      covergroup pmp_region_cg @(posedge clk_i);
175	        option.per_instance = 1;
176	        option.name = "pmp_region_cg";
177	
178	        // This coverpoint converts pmp_add_napot_valid into 32 bins. The onehot call makes sure
179	        // that when the entry is not in NAPOT mode, then no bin is selected. The clog2 call
180	        // converts the value 0...010...0 to the index of the one bit that is set.
181	        cp_napot_addr_modes: coverpoint $clog2(pmp_addr_napot_valid[i_region])
182	          iff ($onehot(pmp_addr_napot_valid[i_region])) {
183	          bins napot_addr[] = { [0:31] };
184	        }
185	
186	        cp_warl_check_pmpcfg : coverpoint
187	          g_pmp_fcov_signals.g_pmp_region_fcov[i_region].fcov_warl_check_pmpcfg;
188	
189	        cp_region_mode : coverpoint csr_pmp_cfg[i_region].mode;
190	
191	        cp_region_priv_bits : coverpoint pmp_region_priv_bits {
192	          wildcard illegal_bins illegal = {5'b0??10};
193	        }
194	
195	        cp_priv_lvl_iside : coverpoint g_pmp.pmp_priv_lvl[PMP_I] {
196	          illegal_bins illegal = {PRIV_LVL_H, PRIV_LVL_S};
197	        }
198	
199	        cp_req_type_iside : coverpoint g_pmp.pmp_req_type[PMP_I] {
200	          illegal_bins illegal = {PMP_ACC_WRITE, PMP_ACC_READ};
201	        }
202	
203	        cp_priv_lvl_iside2 : coverpoint g_pmp.pmp_priv_lvl[PMP_I2] {
204	          illegal_bins illegal = {PRIV_LVL_H, PRIV_LVL_S};
205	        }
206	
207	        cp_req_type_iside2 : coverpoint g_pmp.pmp_req_type[PMP_I2] {
208	          illegal_bins illegal = {PMP_ACC_WRITE, PMP_ACC_READ};
209	        }
210	
211	        cp_priv_lvl_dside : coverpoint g_pmp.pmp_priv_lvl[PMP_D] {
212	          illegal_bins illegal = {PRIV_LVL_H, PRIV_LVL_S};
213	        }
214	
215	        cp_req_type_dside : coverpoint g_pmp.pmp_req_type[PMP_D] {
216	          illegal_bins illegal = {PMP_ACC_EXEC};
217	        }
218	
219	        // Wildcards in crosses are not supported by VCS. As a workaround we are using `with`
220	        // keyword and basic logic expressions to constraint the condition as appropriate.
221	        pmp_iside_mode_cross : cross cp_region_mode, pmp_iside_req_err
222	          iff (g_pmp_fcov_signals.g_pmp_region_fcov[i_region].fcov_pmp_region_ichan_access) {
223	            illegal_bins illegal_off_mode_match = binsof(cp_region_mode) intersect {PMP_MODE_OFF};
224	          }
225	
226	        pmp_iside2_mode_cross : cross cp_region_mode, pmp_iside2_req_err
227	          iff (g_pmp_fcov_signals.g_pmp_region_fcov[i_region].fcov_pmp_region_ichan2_access) {
228	            illegal_bins illegal_off_mode_match = binsof(cp_region_mode) intersect {PMP_MODE_OFF};
229	          }
230	
231	        pmp_dside_mode_cross : cross cp_region_mode, pmp_dside_req_err
232	          iff (g_pmp_fcov_signals.g_pmp_region_fcov[i_region].fcov_pmp_region_dchan_access) {
233	            illegal_bins illegal_off_mode_match = binsof(cp_region_mode) intersect {PMP_MODE_OFF};
234	          }
235	
236	        pmp_iside_priv_bits_cross :
237	          cross cp_region_priv_bits, cp_req_type_iside, cp_priv_lvl_iside, pmp_iside_req_err
238	            iff (g_pmp_fcov_signals.g_pmp_region_fcov[i_region].fcov_pmp_region_ichan_access &&
239	                 g_pmp_fcov_signals.fcov_pmp_region_ichan_priority[i_region]                 &&
240	                 csr_pmp_cfg[i_region].mode != PMP_MODE_OFF) {
241	
242	            // Will never see a succesful exec access when execute is disallowed
243	            illegal_bins illegal_allow_exec =
244	              // Ensuring MML is low and we are not in a X allowed configuration
245	              (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {NONE, R, W, WR, L, LR, LW, LWR} &&
246	               binsof(cp_req_type_iside) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
247	               binsof(pmp_iside_req_err) intersect {0}) with (cp_priv_lvl_iside == PRIV_LVL_U ||
248	                                                              (|(cp_region_priv_bits & 5'b01000)));
249	            illegal_bins illegal_machine_allow_exec =
250	              // Ensuring MML is high and we are not in a X allowed configuration in Machine Mode
251	              (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {MML_NONE, MML_RU, MML_WRM_RU, MML_WRU, MML_XU,
252	                                                   MML_XRU, MML_WRM_WRU, MML_XWRU, MML_L, MML_RM,
253	                                                   MML_WRM, MML_RM_RU} &&
254	               binsof(cp_priv_lvl_iside) intersect {PRIV_LVL_M} &&
255	               binsof(cp_req_type_iside) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
256	               binsof(pmp_iside_req_err) intersect {0});
257	            illegal_bins illegal_user_allow_exec =
258	              // Ensuring MML is high and we are not in a X allowed configuration in User Mode
259	              (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {MML_NONE, MML_RU, MML_WRM_RU, MML_WRU,
260	                                                      MML_WRM_WRU, MML_L, MML_RM, MML_WRM,
261	                                                      MML_XM, MML_XRM, MML_RM_RU} &&
262	               binsof(cp_priv_lvl_iside) intersect {PRIV_LVL_U} &&
263	               binsof(cp_req_type_iside) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
264	               binsof(pmp_iside_req_err) intersect {0});
265	            // Will never see an exec access denied when executed is allowed
266	            illegal_bins illegal_deny_exec =
267	              // Ensuring MML is low and we are in a X allowed configuration
268	              (binsof(cp_req_type_iside) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
269	               binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {X, XW, XR, XWR, LX, LXW, LXR, LXWR} &&
270	               binsof(pmp_iside_req_err) intersect {1});
271	            illegal_bins illegal_deny_exec_machine_unlocked =
272	              // Ensuring in machine mode when MML is low, we are in X allowed configuration
273	              (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {R, W, WR} &&
274	               binsof(cp_req_type_iside) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
275	               binsof(cp_priv_lvl_iside) intersect {PRIV_LVL_M} &&
276	               binsof(pmp_iside_req_err) intersect {1});
277	            illegal_bins illegal_machine_deny_exec =
278	              // Ensuring MML is high and we are in a X allowed configuration in Machine Mode
279	              (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {NONE, MML_XM_XU, MML_XRM_XU, MML_XRM,
280	                                                      MML_XM} &&
281	               binsof(cp_priv_lvl_iside) intersect {PRIV_LVL_M} &&
282	               binsof(cp_req_type_iside) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
283	               binsof(pmp_iside_req_err) intersect {1});
284	            illegal_bins illegal_user_deny_exec =
285	              // Ensuring MML is high and we are in a X allowed configuration in User Mode
286	              (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {MML_XM_XU, MML_XRM_XU, MML_XRU, MML_XU,
287	                                                      MML_XWRU} &&
288	               binsof(cp_priv_lvl_iside) intersect {PRIV_LVL_U} &&
289	               binsof(cp_req_type_iside) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
290	               binsof(pmp_iside_req_err) intersect {1});
291	        }
292	
293	        pmp_iside2_priv_bits_cross :
294	          cross cp_region_priv_bits, cp_req_type_iside2, cp_priv_lvl_iside2, pmp_iside2_req_err
295	            iff (g_pmp_fcov_signals.g_pmp_region_fcov[i_region].fcov_pmp_region_ichan2_access &&
296	                 g_pmp_fcov_signals.fcov_pmp_region_ichan2_priority[i_region]                 &&
297	                 csr_pmp_cfg[i_region].mode != PMP_MODE_OFF) {
298	
299	          // Will never see a succesful exec access when execute is disallowed
300	          illegal_bins illegal_allow_exec =
301	            // Ensuring MML is low and we are not in a X allowed configuration
302	            (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {NONE, R, W, WR, L, LR, LW, LWR} &&
303	             binsof(cp_req_type_iside2) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
304	             binsof(pmp_iside2_req_err) intersect {0}) with (cp_priv_lvl_iside2 == PRIV_LVL_U ||
305	                                                             (cp_region_priv_bits & 5'b01000));
306	          illegal_bins illegal_machine_allow_exec =
307	            // Ensuring MML is high and we are not in a X allowed configuration in Machine Mode
308	            (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {MML_NONE, MML_RU, MML_WRM_RU, MML_WRU, MML_XU,
309	                                                 MML_XRU, MML_WRM_WRU, MML_XWRU, MML_L, MML_RM,
310	                                                 MML_WRM, MML_RM_RU} &&
311	             binsof(cp_priv_lvl_iside2) intersect {PRIV_LVL_M} &&
312	             binsof(cp_req_type_iside2) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
313	             binsof(pmp_iside2_req_err) intersect {0});
314	          illegal_bins illegal_user_allow_exec =
315	            // Ensuring MML is high and we are not in a X allowed configuration in User Mode
316	            (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {MML_NONE, MML_RU, MML_WRM_RU, MML_WRU,
317	                                                    MML_WRM_WRU, MML_L, MML_RM, MML_WRM,
318	                                                    MML_XM, MML_XRM, MML_RM_RU} &&
319	             binsof(cp_priv_lvl_iside2) intersect {PRIV_LVL_U} &&
320	             binsof(cp_req_type_iside2) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
321	             binsof(pmp_iside2_req_err) intersect {0});
322	
323	          // Will never see an exec access denied when execute is allowed
324	          illegal_bins illegal_deny_exec =
325	            // Ensuring MML is low and we are in a X allowed configuration
326	            (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {X, XW, XR, XWR, LX, LXW, LXR, LXWR} &&
327	             binsof(cp_req_type_iside2) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
328	             binsof(pmp_iside2_req_err) intersect {1});
329	          illegal_bins illegal_deny_exec_machine_unlocked =
330	            // Ensuring in machine mode when MML is low, we are in X allowed configuration
331	            (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {R, W, WR} &&
332	             binsof(cp_req_type_iside2) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
333	             binsof(cp_priv_lvl_iside2) intersect {PRIV_LVL_M} &&
334	             binsof(pmp_iside2_req_err) intersect {1});
335	          illegal_bins illegal_machine_deny_exec =
336	            // Ensuring MML is high and we are in a X allowed configuration in Machine Mode
337	            (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {NONE, MML_XM_XU, MML_XRM_XU, MML_XRM, MML_XM} &&
338	             binsof(cp_priv_lvl_iside2) intersect {PRIV_LVL_M} &&
339	             binsof(cp_req_type_iside2) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
340	             binsof(pmp_iside2_req_err) intersect {1});
341	          illegal_bins illegal_user_deny_exec =
342	            // Ensuring MML is high and we are in a X allowed configuration in User Mode
343	            (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {MML_XM_XU, MML_XRM_XU, MML_XRU, MML_XU,
344	                                                      MML_XWRU} &&
345	             binsof(cp_priv_lvl_iside2) intersect {PRIV_LVL_U} &&

7	module ibex_pmp #(
8	  // Granularity of NAPOT access,
9	  // 0 = No restriction, 1 = 8 byte, 2 = 16 byte, 3 = 32 byte, etc.
10	  parameter int unsigned PMPGranularity = 0,
11	  // Number of access channels (e.g. i-side + d-side)
12	  parameter int unsigned PMPNumChan     = 2,
13	  // Number of implemented regions
14	  parameter int unsigned PMPNumRegions  = 4
15	) (
16	  // Interface to CSRs
17	  input  ibex_pkg::pmp_cfg_t      csr_pmp_cfg_i     [PMPNumRegions],
18	  input  logic [33:0]             csr_pmp_addr_i    [PMPNumRegions],
19	  input  ibex_pkg::pmp_mseccfg_t  csr_pmp_mseccfg_i,
20	
21	  input  ibex_pkg::priv_lvl_e     priv_mode_i    [PMPNumChan],
22	  // Access checking channels
23	  input  logic [33:0]             pmp_req_addr_i [PMPNumChan],
24	  input  ibex_pkg::pmp_req_e      pmp_req_type_i [PMPNumChan],
25	  output logic                    pmp_req_err_o  [PMPNumChan]
26	
27	);
28	
29	  import ibex_pkg::*;
30	
31	  // Access Checking Signals
32	  logic [33:0]                                region_start_addr [PMPNumRegions];
33	  logic [33:PMPGranularity+2]                 region_addr_mask  [PMPNumRegions];
34	  logic [PMPNumChan-1:0][PMPNumRegions-1:0]   region_match_gt;
35	  logic [PMPNumChan-1:0][PMPNumRegions-1:0]   region_match_lt;
36	  logic [PMPNumChan-1:0][PMPNumRegions-1:0]   region_match_eq;
37	  logic [PMPNumChan-1:0][PMPNumRegions-1:0]   region_match_all;
38	  logic [PMPNumChan-1:0][PMPNumRegions-1:0]   region_basic_perm_check;
39	  logic [PMPNumChan-1:0][PMPNumRegions-1:0]   region_perm_check;
40	
41	  ///////////////////////
42	  // Functions for PMP //
43	  ///////////////////////
44	
45	  // Flow of the PMP checking operation follows as below
46	  //
47	  // basic_perm_check ---> perm_check_wrapper ---> mml_perm_check/orig_perm_check ---/
48	  //                                                                                 |
49	  // region_match_all --------------------------------> access_fault_check <----------
50	  //                                                            |
51	  //                                                            \--> pmp_req_err_o
52	
53	  // Compute permissions checks that apply when MSECCFG.MML is set. Added for Smepmp support.
54	  function automatic logic mml_perm_check(ibex_pkg::pmp_cfg_t  region_csr_pmp_cfg,
55	                                          ibex_pkg::pmp_req_e  pmp_req_type,
56	                                          ibex_pkg::priv_lvl_e priv_mode,
57	                                          logic                permission_check);
58	    logic result = 1'b0;
59	    logic unused_cfg = |region_csr_pmp_cfg.mode;
60	
61	    if (!region_csr_pmp_cfg.read && region_csr_pmp_cfg.write) begin
62	      // Special-case shared regions where R = 0, W = 1
63	      unique case ({region_csr_pmp_cfg.lock, region_csr_pmp_cfg.exec})
64	        // Read/write in M, read only in S/U
65	        2'b00: result =
66	            (pmp_req_type == PMP_ACC_READ) |
67	            ((pmp_req_type == PMP_ACC_WRITE) & (priv_mode == PRIV_LVL_M));
68	        // Read/write in M/S/U
69	        2'b01: result =
70	            (pmp_req_type == PMP_ACC_READ) | (pmp_req_type == PMP_ACC_WRITE);
71	        // Execute only on M/S/U
72	        2'b10: result = (pmp_req_type == PMP_ACC_EXEC);
73	        // Read/execute in M, execute only on S/U
74	        2'b11: result =
75	            (pmp_req_type == PMP_ACC_EXEC) |
76	            ((pmp_req_type == PMP_ACC_READ) & (priv_mode == PRIV_LVL_M));
77	        default: ;
78	      endcase
79	    end else begin
80	      if (region_csr_pmp_cfg.read & region_csr_pmp_cfg.write &
81	          region_csr_pmp_cfg.exec & region_csr_pmp_cfg.lock) begin
82	        // Special-case shared read only region when R = 1, W = 1, X = 1, L = 1
83	        result = pmp_req_type == PMP_ACC_READ;
84	      end else begin
85	        // Otherwise use basic permission check. Permission is always denied if in S/U mode and
86	        // L is set or if in M mode and L is unset.
87	        result = permission_check &
88	                 (priv_mode == PRIV_LVL_M ? region_csr_pmp_cfg.lock : ~region_csr_pmp_cfg.lock);
89	      end
90	    end
91	    return result;
92	  endfunction
93	
94	  // Compute permissions checks that apply when MSECCFG.MML is unset. This is the original PMP
95	  // behaviour before Smepmp was added.
96	  function automatic logic orig_perm_check(logic                pmp_cfg_lock,
97	                                           ibex_pkg::priv_lvl_e priv_mode,
98	                                           logic                permission_check);
99	      return (priv_mode == PRIV_LVL_M) ?
100	          // For M-mode, any region which matches with the L-bit clear, or with sufficient
101	          // access permissions will be allowed
102	          (~pmp_cfg_lock | permission_check) :
103	          // For other modes, the lock bit doesn't matter
104	          permission_check;
105	  endfunction
106	
107	  // A wrapper function in which it is decided which form of permission check function gets called
108	  function automatic logic perm_check_wrapper(logic                csr_pmp_mseccfg_mml,
109	                                              ibex_pkg::pmp_cfg_t  region_csr_pmp_cfg,
110	                                              ibex_pkg::pmp_req_e  pmp_req_type,
111	                                              ibex_pkg::priv_lvl_e priv_mode,
112	                                              logic                permission_check);
113	    return csr_pmp_mseccfg_mml ? mml_perm_check(region_csr_pmp_cfg,
114	                                                pmp_req_type,
115	                                                priv_mode,
116	                                                permission_check) :
117	                                 orig_perm_check(region_csr_pmp_cfg.lock,
118	                                                 priv_mode,
119	                                                 permission_check);
120	  endfunction
121	
122	  // Access fault determination / prioritization
123	  function automatic logic access_fault_check (logic                     csr_pmp_mseccfg_mmwp,
124	                                               logic                     csr_pmp_mseccfg_mml,
125	                                               ibex_pkg::pmp_req_e       pmp_req_type,
126	                                               logic [PMPNumRegions-1:0] match_all,
127	                                               ibex_pkg::priv_lvl_e      priv_mode,
128	                                               logic [PMPNumRegions-1:0] final_perm_check);
129	
130	
131	    // When MSECCFG.MMWP is set default deny always, otherwise allow for M-mode, deny for other
132	    // modes. Also deny unmatched for M-mode whe MSECCFG.MML is set and request type is EXEC.
133	    logic access_fail = csr_pmp_mseccfg_mmwp | (priv_mode != PRIV_LVL_M) |
134	                        (csr_pmp_mseccfg_mml && (pmp_req_type == PMP_ACC_EXEC));
135	    logic matched = 1'b0;
136	
137	    // PMP entries are statically prioritized, from 0 to N-1
138	    // The lowest-numbered PMP entry which matches an address determines accessibility
139	    for (int r = 0; r < PMPNumRegions; r++) begin
140	      if (!matched && match_all[r]) begin
141	        access_fail = ~final_perm_check[r];
142	        matched = 1'b1;
143	      end
144	    end
145	    return access_fail;
146	  endfunction
147	
148	  // ---------------
149	  // Access checking
150	  // ---------------
151	
152	  for (genvar r = 0; r < PMPNumRegions; r++) begin : g_addr_exp
153	    // Start address for TOR matching
154	    if (r == 0) begin : g_entry0
155	      assign region_start_addr[r] = (csr_pmp_cfg_i[r].mode == PMP_MODE_TOR) ? 34'h000000000 :
156	                                                                              csr_pmp_addr_i[r];
157	    end else begin : g_oth
158	      assign region_start_addr[r] = (csr_pmp_cfg_i[r].mode == PMP_MODE_TOR) ? csr_pmp_addr_i[r-1] :
159	                                                                              csr_pmp_addr_i[r];
160	    end
161	    // Address mask for NA matching
162	    for (genvar b = PMPGranularity + 2; b < 34; b++) begin : g_bitmask
163	      if (b == 2) begin : g_bit0
164	        // Always mask bit 2 for NAPOT
165	        assign region_addr_mask[r][b] = (csr_pmp_cfg_i[r].mode != PMP_MODE_NAPOT);
166	      end else begin : g_others
167	        // We will mask this bit if it is within the programmed granule
168	        // i.e. addr = yyyy 0111
169	        //                  ^
170	        //                  | This bit pos is the top of the mask, all lower bits set
171	        // thus mask = 1111 0000
172	        if (PMPGranularity == 0) begin : g_region_addr_mask_zero_granularity
173	          assign region_addr_mask[r][b] = (csr_pmp_cfg_i[r].mode != PMP_MODE_NAPOT) |
174	                                          ~&csr_pmp_addr_i[r][b-1:2];
175	        end else begin : g_region_addr_mask_other_granularity
176	          assign region_addr_mask[r][b] = (csr_pmp_cfg_i[r].mode != PMP_MODE_NAPOT) |
177	                                          ~&csr_pmp_addr_i[r][b-1:PMPGranularity+1];
178	        end
179	      end
180	    end
181	  end
182	
183	  for (genvar c = 0; c < PMPNumChan; c++) begin : g_access_check
184	    for (genvar r = 0; r < PMPNumRegions; r++) begin : g_regions
185	      // Comparators are sized according to granularity
186	      assign region_match_eq[c][r] = (pmp_req_addr_i[c][33:PMPGranularity+2] &
187	                                      region_addr_mask[r]) ==
188	                                     (region_start_addr[r][33:PMPGranularity+2] &
189	                                      region_addr_mask[r]);
190	      assign region_match_gt[c][r] = pmp_req_addr_i[c][33:PMPGranularity+2] >
191	                                     region_start_addr[r][33:PMPGranularity+2];
192	      assign region_match_lt[c][r] = pmp_req_addr_i[c][33:PMPGranularity+2] <
193	                                     csr_pmp_addr_i[r][33:PMPGranularity+2];
194	
195	      always_comb begin
196	        region_match_all[c][r] = 1'b0;
197	        unique case (csr_pmp_cfg_i[r].mode)
198	          PMP_MODE_OFF:   region_match_all[c][r] = 1'b0;
199	          PMP_MODE_NA4:   region_match_all[c][r] = region_match_eq[c][r];
200	          PMP_MODE_NAPOT: region_match_all[c][r] = region_match_eq[c][r];
201	          PMP_MODE_TOR: begin
202	            region_match_all[c][r] = (region_match_eq[c][r] | region_match_gt[c][r]) &
203	                                     region_match_lt[c][r];
204	          end
205	          default:        region_match_all[c][r] = 1'b0;
206	        endcase
207	      end
208	
209	      // Basic permission check compares cfg register only.
210	      assign region_basic_perm_check[c][r] =
211	          ((pmp_req_type_i[c] == PMP_ACC_EXEC)  & csr_pmp_cfg_i[r].exec) |
212	          ((pmp_req_type_i[c] == PMP_ACC_WRITE) & csr_pmp_cfg_i[r].write) |
213	          ((pmp_req_type_i[c] == PMP_ACC_READ)  & csr_pmp_cfg_i[r].read);
214	
215	      // Check specific required permissions since the behaviour is different
216	      // between Smepmp implementation and original PMP.
217	      assign region_perm_check[c][r] = perm_check_wrapper(csr_pmp_mseccfg_i.mml,
218	                                                          csr_pmp_cfg_i[r],
219	                                                          pmp_req_type_i[c],
220	                                                          priv_mode_i[c],
221	                                                          region_basic_perm_check[c][r]);
222	
223	      // Address bits below PMP granularity (which starts at 4 byte) are deliberately unused.
224	      logic unused_sigs;
225	      assign unused_sigs = ^{region_start_addr[r][PMPGranularity+2-1:0],
226	                             pmp_req_addr_i[c][PMPGranularity+2-1:0]};
227	    end
228	
229	    // Once the permission checks of the regions are done, decide if the access is
230	    // denied by figuring out the matching region and its permission check.
231	    assign pmp_req_err_o[c] = access_fault_check(csr_pmp_mseccfg_i.mmwp,
232	                                                 csr_pmp_mseccfg_i.mml,
233	                                                 pmp_req_type_i[c],
234	                                                 region_match_all[c],
235	                                                 priv_mode_i[c],
236	                                                 region_perm_check[c]);
237	
238	    // Access fails check against one region but access allowed due to another higher-priority
239	    // region.
240	    `DV_FCOV_SIGNAL(logic, pmp_region_override,
241	      ~pmp_req_err_o[c] & |(region_match_all[c] & ~region_perm_check[c]))
242	  end
243	
244	  // RLB, rule locking bypass, is only relevant to ibex_cs_registers which controls writes to the
245	  // PMP CSRs. Tie to unused signal here to prevent lint warnings.
246	  logic unused_csr_pmp_mseccfg_rlb;
247	  assign unused_csr_pmp_mseccfg_rlb = csr_pmp_mseccfg_i.rlb;
248	endmodule

5	`include "prim_assert.sv"
6	
7	interface core_ibex_pmp_fcov_if import ibex_pkg::*; #(
8	    parameter bit          PMPEnable      = 1'b0,
9	    // Granularity of NAPOT access,
10	    // 0 = No restriction, 1 = 8 byte, 2 = 16 byte, 3 = 32 byte, etc.
11	    parameter int unsigned PMPGranularity = 0,
12	    // Number of implemented regions
13	    parameter int unsigned PMPNumRegions  = 4
14	) (
15	  input clk_i,
16	  input rst_ni,
17	
18	  input ibex_pkg::pmp_cfg_t  csr_pmp_cfg     [PMPNumRegions],
19	  input logic[33:0]          csr_pmp_addr    [PMPNumRegions],
20	  input logic                pmp_req_err     [3],
21	  input pmp_mseccfg_t        csr_pmp_mseccfg,
22	
23	  input logic data_req_out,
24	
25	  input fcov_csr_write
26	);
27	  localparam int unsigned PMPNumChan = 3;
28	
29	  `include "dv_fcov_macros.svh"
30	  import uvm_pkg::*;
31	
32	  // Enum to give more readable coverage results for privilege bits. 4 bits are from the pmpcfg CSF
33	  // (L, X, W, R) and the 5th is the MML bit. Setting the MML bit changes the meaning of the other
34	  // 4 bits
35	  typedef enum logic [4:0] {
36	    NONE        = 5'b00000,
37	    R           = 5'b00001,
38	    W           = 5'b00010,
39	    WR          = 5'b00011,
40	    X           = 5'b00100,
41	    XR          = 5'b00101,
42	    XW          = 5'b00110,
43	    XWR         = 5'b00111,
44	    L           = 5'b01000,
45	    LR          = 5'b01001,
46	    LW          = 5'b01010,
47	    LWR         = 5'b01011,
48	    LX          = 5'b01100,
49	    LXR         = 5'b01101,
50	    LXW         = 5'b01110,
51	    LXWR        = 5'b01111,
52	    MML_NONE    = 5'b10000,
53	    MML_RU      = 5'b10001,
54	    MML_WRM_RU  = 5'b10010,
55	    MML_WRU     = 5'b10011,
56	    MML_XU      = 5'b10100,
57	    MML_XRU     = 5'b10101,
58	    MML_WRM_WRU = 5'b10110,
59	    MML_XWRU    = 5'b10111,
60	    MML_L       = 5'b11000,
61	    MML_RM      = 5'b11001,
62	    MML_XM_XU   = 5'b11010,
63	    MML_WRM     = 5'b11011,
64	    MML_XM      = 5'b11100,
65	    MML_XRM     = 5'b11101,
66	    MML_XRM_XU  = 5'b11110,
67	    MML_RM_RU   = 5'b11111
68	  } pmp_priv_bits_e;
69	
70	  // Break out PMP signals into individually named signals for direct use in `cross` as it cannot
71	  // deal with hierarchical references or unpacked arrays.
72	  logic pmp_iside_req_err;
73	  logic pmp_iside2_req_err;
74	  logic pmp_dside_req_err;
75	
76	  assign pmp_iside_req_err  = pmp_req_err[PMP_I];
77	  assign pmp_iside2_req_err = pmp_req_err[PMP_I2];
78	  assign pmp_dside_req_err  = pmp_req_err[PMP_D];
79	
80	  logic [PMPNumRegions-1:0] current_priv_perm_check;
81	  bit en_pmp_fcov;
82	
83	  logic csr_wdata_mseccfg_rlb;
84	  logic csr_wdata_mseccfg_mmwp;
85	  logic csr_wdata_mseccfg_mml;
86	
87	  assign csr_wdata_mseccfg_rlb = cs_registers_i.csr_wdata_int[CSR_MSECCFG_RLB_BIT];
88	  assign csr_wdata_mseccfg_mmwp = cs_registers_i.csr_wdata_int[CSR_MSECCFG_MMWP_BIT];
89	  assign csr_wdata_mseccfg_mml = cs_registers_i.csr_wdata_int[CSR_MSECCFG_MML_BIT];
90	
91	  initial begin
92	    if (PMPEnable) begin
93	      void'($value$plusargs("enable_ibex_fcov=%d", en_pmp_fcov));
94	    end else begin
95	      en_pmp_fcov = 1'b0;
96	    end
97	  end
98	
99	  if (PMPEnable) begin : g_pmp_cgs
100	    logic [PMPNumRegions-1:0] pmp_iside_match;
101	    logic [PMPNumRegions-1:0] pmp_iside2_match;
102	    logic [PMPNumRegions-1:0] pmp_dside_match;
103	    logic [PMPNumRegions-1:0] pmp_dside_match_last;
104	
105	    logic pmp_iside_nomatch;
106	    logic pmp_iside2_nomatch;
107	    logic pmp_dside_nomatch;
108	
109	    logic pmp_iside_boundary_cross;
110	    logic pmp_dside_boundary_cross;
111	
112	    logic misaligned_pmp_err_last;
113	
114	    logic [31:0] pmp_addr_napot_valid [PMPNumRegions];
115	
116	    assign pmp_iside_match      = g_pmp.pmp_i.region_match_all[PMP_I];
117	    assign pmp_iside2_match     = g_pmp.pmp_i.region_match_all[PMP_I2];
118	    assign pmp_dside_match      = g_pmp.pmp_i.region_match_all[PMP_D];
119	
120	    assign pmp_iside_nomatch  = ~|pmp_iside_match;
121	    assign pmp_iside2_nomatch = ~|pmp_iside2_match;
122	    assign pmp_dside_nomatch  = ~|pmp_dside_match;
123	
124	    // Store the Data Channel PMP match info from the first request to calculate boundary cross
125	    always @(posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni) begin
126	      if (!rst_ni) begin
127	        pmp_dside_match_last    <= '0;
128	        misaligned_pmp_err_last <= 1'b0;
129	      end else if (load_store_unit_i.fcov_ls_first_req) begin
130	        pmp_dside_match_last    <= pmp_dside_match;
131	        misaligned_pmp_err_last <= load_store_unit_i.data_pmp_err_i;
132	      end
133	    end
134	
135	    assign pmp_iside_boundary_cross = |(pmp_iside_match ^ pmp_iside2_match);
136	    assign pmp_dside_boundary_cross = |(pmp_dside_match ^ pmp_dside_match_last) &
137	                                      load_store_unit_i.fcov_ls_second_req;
138	
139	    for (genvar i_region = 0; i_region < PMPNumRegions; i_region += 1) begin : g_pmp_region_fcov
140	      pmp_priv_bits_e pmp_region_priv_bits;
141	      pmp_priv_bits_e pmp_region_priv_bits_wr;
142	
143	      assign pmp_region_priv_bits = pmp_priv_bits_e'({csr_pmp_mseccfg.mml,
144	                                                      csr_pmp_cfg[i_region].lock,
145	                                                      csr_pmp_cfg[i_region].exec,
146	                                                      csr_pmp_cfg[i_region].write,
147	                                                      csr_pmp_cfg[i_region].read});
148	      assign pmp_region_priv_bits_wr =
149	          pmp_priv_bits_e'({csr_pmp_mseccfg.mml,
150	                            cs_registers_i.g_pmp_registers.pmp_cfg_wdata[i_region].lock,
151	                            cs_registers_i.g_pmp_registers.pmp_cfg_wdata[i_region].exec,
152	                            cs_registers_i.g_pmp_registers.pmp_cfg_wdata[i_region].write,
153	                            cs_registers_i.g_pmp_registers.pmp_cfg_wdata[i_region].read});
154	
155	      // Do the permission check for Data channel with the privilege level from Instruction channels.
156	      // This way we can check the effect of mstatus.mprv changing privilege levels for LSU related
157	      // operations.
158	      assign current_priv_perm_check[i_region] =
159	        g_pmp.pmp_i.perm_check_wrapper(csr_pmp_mseccfg.mml,
160	                                       csr_pmp_cfg[i_region],
161	                                       g_pmp.pmp_i.pmp_req_type_i[PMP_D],
162	                                       cs_registers_i.priv_mode_id_o,
163	                                       g_pmp.pmp_i.region_basic_perm_check[PMP_D][i_region]);
164	
165	      // Each cycle this assignment creates either the value 0 if the mode is not NAPOT or 1 bit is
166	      // set based on how large the NAPOT region is. The size of the NAPOT region is essentially
167	      // encoded by how many consecutive ones there are after the last 0. This encoding is
168	      // specified in the "Physical Memory Protection" section of the RISC-V privileged spec.
169	      for (genvar i = 0; i < 32; i += 1) begin : g_pmp_napot_region_fcov
170	        assign pmp_addr_napot_valid[i_region][i] = csr_pmp_cfg[i_region].mode == PMP_MODE_NAPOT &&
171	          (csr_pmp_addr[i_region][i+2:2] == {1'b0, {i{1'b1}}});
172	      end
173	
174	      covergroup pmp_region_cg @(posedge clk_i);
175	        option.per_instance = 1;
176	        option.name = "pmp_region_cg";
177	
178	        // This coverpoint converts pmp_add_napot_valid into 32 bins. The onehot call makes sure
179	        // that when the entry is not in NAPOT mode, then no bin is selected. The clog2 call
180	        // converts the value 0...010...0 to the index of the one bit that is set.
181	        cp_napot_addr_modes: coverpoint $clog2(pmp_addr_napot_valid[i_region])
182	          iff ($onehot(pmp_addr_napot_valid[i_region])) {
183	          bins napot_addr[] = { [0:31] };
184	        }
185	
186	        cp_warl_check_pmpcfg : coverpoint
187	          g_pmp_fcov_signals.g_pmp_region_fcov[i_region].fcov_warl_check_pmpcfg;
188	
189	        cp_region_mode : coverpoint csr_pmp_cfg[i_region].mode;
190	
191	        cp_region_priv_bits : coverpoint pmp_region_priv_bits {
192	          wildcard illegal_bins illegal = {5'b0??10};
193	        }
194	
195	        cp_priv_lvl_iside : coverpoint g_pmp.pmp_priv_lvl[PMP_I] {
196	          illegal_bins illegal = {PRIV_LVL_H, PRIV_LVL_S};
197	        }
198	
199	        cp_req_type_iside : coverpoint g_pmp.pmp_req_type[PMP_I] {
200	          illegal_bins illegal = {PMP_ACC_WRITE, PMP_ACC_READ};
201	        }
202	
203	        cp_priv_lvl_iside2 : coverpoint g_pmp.pmp_priv_lvl[PMP_I2] {
204	          illegal_bins illegal = {PRIV_LVL_H, PRIV_LVL_S};
205	        }
206	
207	        cp_req_type_iside2 : coverpoint g_pmp.pmp_req_type[PMP_I2] {
208	          illegal_bins illegal = {PMP_ACC_WRITE, PMP_ACC_READ};
209	        }
210	
211	        cp_priv_lvl_dside : coverpoint g_pmp.pmp_priv_lvl[PMP_D] {
212	          illegal_bins illegal = {PRIV_LVL_H, PRIV_LVL_S};
213	        }
214	
215	        cp_req_type_dside : coverpoint g_pmp.pmp_req_type[PMP_D] {
216	          illegal_bins illegal = {PMP_ACC_EXEC};
217	        }
218	
219	        // Wildcards in crosses are not supported by VCS. As a workaround we are using `with`
220	        // keyword and basic logic expressions to constraint the condition as appropriate.
221	        pmp_iside_mode_cross : cross cp_region_mode, pmp_iside_req_err
222	          iff (g_pmp_fcov_signals.g_pmp_region_fcov[i_region].fcov_pmp_region_ichan_access) {
223	            illegal_bins illegal_off_mode_match = binsof(cp_region_mode) intersect {PMP_MODE_OFF};
224	          }
225	
226	        pmp_iside2_mode_cross : cross cp_region_mode, pmp_iside2_req_err
227	          iff (g_pmp_fcov_signals.g_pmp_region_fcov[i_region].fcov_pmp_region_ichan2_access) {
228	            illegal_bins illegal_off_mode_match = binsof(cp_region_mode) intersect {PMP_MODE_OFF};
229	          }
230	
231	        pmp_dside_mode_cross : cross cp_region_mode, pmp_dside_req_err
232	          iff (g_pmp_fcov_signals.g_pmp_region_fcov[i_region].fcov_pmp_region_dchan_access) {
233	            illegal_bins illegal_off_mode_match = binsof(cp_region_mode) intersect {PMP_MODE_OFF};
234	          }
235	
236	        pmp_iside_priv_bits_cross :
237	          cross cp_region_priv_bits, cp_req_type_iside, cp_priv_lvl_iside, pmp_iside_req_err
238	            iff (g_pmp_fcov_signals.g_pmp_region_fcov[i_region].fcov_pmp_region_ichan_access &&
239	                 g_pmp_fcov_signals.fcov_pmp_region_ichan_priority[i_region]                 &&
240	                 csr_pmp_cfg[i_region].mode != PMP_MODE_OFF) {
241	
242	            // Will never see a succesful exec access when execute is disallowed
243	            illegal_bins illegal_allow_exec =
244	              // Ensuring MML is low and we are not in a X allowed configuration
245	              (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {NONE, R, W, WR, L, LR, LW, LWR} &&
246	               binsof(cp_req_type_iside) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
247	               binsof(pmp_iside_req_err) intersect {0}) with (cp_priv_lvl_iside == PRIV_LVL_U ||
248	                                                              (|(cp_region_priv_bits & 5'b01000)));
249	            illegal_bins illegal_machine_allow_exec =
250	              // Ensuring MML is high and we are not in a X allowed configuration in Machine Mode
251	              (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {MML_NONE, MML_RU, MML_WRM_RU, MML_WRU, MML_XU,
252	                                                   MML_XRU, MML_WRM_WRU, MML_XWRU, MML_L, MML_RM,
253	                                                   MML_WRM, MML_RM_RU} &&
254	               binsof(cp_priv_lvl_iside) intersect {PRIV_LVL_M} &&
255	               binsof(cp_req_type_iside) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
256	               binsof(pmp_iside_req_err) intersect {0});
257	            illegal_bins illegal_user_allow_exec =
258	              // Ensuring MML is high and we are not in a X allowed configuration in User Mode
259	              (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {MML_NONE, MML_RU, MML_WRM_RU, MML_WRU,
260	                                                      MML_WRM_WRU, MML_L, MML_RM, MML_WRM,
261	                                                      MML_XM, MML_XRM, MML_RM_RU} &&
262	               binsof(cp_priv_lvl_iside) intersect {PRIV_LVL_U} &&
263	               binsof(cp_req_type_iside) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
264	               binsof(pmp_iside_req_err) intersect {0});
265	            // Will never see an exec access denied when executed is allowed
266	            illegal_bins illegal_deny_exec =
267	              // Ensuring MML is low and we are in a X allowed configuration
268	              (binsof(cp_req_type_iside) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
269	               binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {X, XW, XR, XWR, LX, LXW, LXR, LXWR} &&
270	               binsof(pmp_iside_req_err) intersect {1});
271	            illegal_bins illegal_deny_exec_machine_unlocked =
272	              // Ensuring in machine mode when MML is low, we are in X allowed configuration
273	              (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {R, W, WR} &&
274	               binsof(cp_req_type_iside) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
275	               binsof(cp_priv_lvl_iside) intersect {PRIV_LVL_M} &&
276	               binsof(pmp_iside_req_err) intersect {1});
277	            illegal_bins illegal_machine_deny_exec =
278	              // Ensuring MML is high and we are in a X allowed configuration in Machine Mode
279	              (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {NONE, MML_XM_XU, MML_XRM_XU, MML_XRM,
280	                                                      MML_XM} &&
281	               binsof(cp_priv_lvl_iside) intersect {PRIV_LVL_M} &&
282	               binsof(cp_req_type_iside) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
283	               binsof(pmp_iside_req_err) intersect {1});
284	            illegal_bins illegal_user_deny_exec =
285	              // Ensuring MML is high and we are in a X allowed configuration in User Mode
286	              (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {MML_XM_XU, MML_XRM_XU, MML_XRU, MML_XU,
287	                                                      MML_XWRU} &&
288	               binsof(cp_priv_lvl_iside) intersect {PRIV_LVL_U} &&
289	               binsof(cp_req_type_iside) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
290	               binsof(pmp_iside_req_err) intersect {1});
291	        }
292	
293	        pmp_iside2_priv_bits_cross :
294	          cross cp_region_priv_bits, cp_req_type_iside2, cp_priv_lvl_iside2, pmp_iside2_req_err
295	            iff (g_pmp_fcov_signals.g_pmp_region_fcov[i_region].fcov_pmp_region_ichan2_access &&
296	                 g_pmp_fcov_signals.fcov_pmp_region_ichan2_priority[i_region]                 &&
297	                 csr_pmp_cfg[i_region].mode != PMP_MODE_OFF) {
298	
299	          // Will never see a succesful exec access when execute is disallowed
300	          illegal_bins illegal_allow_exec =
301	            // Ensuring MML is low and we are not in a X allowed configuration
302	            (binsof(cp_region_priv_bits) intersect {NONE, R, W, WR, L, LR, LW, LWR} &&
303	             binsof(cp_req_type_iside2) intersect {PMP_ACC_EXEC} &&
304	             binsof(pmp_iside2_req_err) intersect {0}) with (cp_priv_lvl_iside2 == PRIV_LVL_U ||
